title: Column align: one width token --gamecult-column (72rem) is .page's max-width everywhere; the studio-page and ritual caps that centred content inside the column go; /Thing's frame reads the token
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md, section 'One column' (map revision 4), facts C1, C7, C8 and the paragraph 'One column'. Ruling: operator-chromeless-column ('aligned like it is on the pages with sidecars'). Follow-up: site-masthead:follow_up:full-width-content, which this cut resolves. Based on 535d170; after sidebars-gone every page is one grid column and custom.scss is about 300 lines shorter. Re-read by selector.

The misalignment (C1): .page is max-width 1680px (33-37) and .gamecult-studio-page centres the article at 72rem inside it (2013-2017), so on / and /Projects the masthead (full .center width) and the article (72rem, centred) have different left edges. The ritual essays do the same with article { max-width: 980px; margin: 2rem auto 4rem } (148-156). The fix is not to centre the masthead too; it is to make the column the content's width, so nothing is centred inside it.

Mechanism: body { --gamecult-column: 72rem; } (1152px, the studio pages' current measure). .page { max-width: var(--gamecult-column); } keeps its gutters (padding 0 1.2rem 2.5rem; the engine's #quartz-body padding below $desktop and the mobile 0.7rem stay). Then .page-header, article and the engine footer are each the column's full width and share its edges. .gamecult-studio-page loses max-width and margin-inline (its --gamecult-studio-copy token stays). The ritual article loses max-width: 980px and its margin becomes 2rem 0 4rem; the paper's measure is its own two text columns (column-count: 2 at 540) and the 760px caps on article h1 and .ritual-paper-titleblock stay as type measures. .page > #quartz-body .center, footer { max-width: none } (89-92) says what the engine's max-width: 100% already says in one column; delete it and confirm .center still equals the grid column.

/Thing: the deck stays full-bleed (.page { max-width: none; padding: 0 } in the Thing block is untouched); --thing-frame becomes calc(var(--gamecult-column) + 2 * var(--thing-inset)) so the masthead and footer boxes on /Thing are the same box as .page everywhere else. No other literal page width remains.

Why 72rem and not the engine's or 1680: the follow-up asks that content fill the width 'where reasonable'; 72rem is the measure the studio pages already chose for prose and media side by side, prose at 1152px is already wide, and the token makes the site's width one number to change after the operator sees it. Not a fork.

Brand doc: a '## Layout' section after '## Surfaces': the site is one centred column, --gamecult-column (72rem) on body, .page's max-width; the masthead, article and footer share its edges on every page; nothing is centred inside it; a full-bleed surface (the Thing deck, the VN on tour/Pitch) may escape the column while its masthead and footer keep the frame; the remaining caps (760px on the ritual h1 and title block, 68ch on the tagline) are type measures, not chrome. This is the Layout section the follow-up asked for.

The tour/Pitch block (.page max-width none, 100svh) is unchanged.

authority_map.owner: custom.scss body owns the site's width through --gamecult-column; .page is the only rule that applies it as a width; the Thing block derives its frame from it.
inputs: the gutters (.page padding; the engine's #quartz-body padding below $desktop; --thing-inset on /Thing)
outputs: on every page the masthead, the article and the site footer have the same left and right edges, the column's; on /Thing the deck is full-bleed and the masthead and footer keep the column's frame
derived_state: the masthead's, article's and footer's widths are derived from the column; .gamecult-studio-page and the ritual article are no longer owners of a width
--thing-frame is derived from --gamecult-column and --thing-inset; no literal page width exists
full-width-content is resolved: the column is the one width; the 760px and 68ch caps are type measures named in the brand doc
forbidden_writers: no max-width with an auto margin on an article, page class or .center (the Thing footer's margin-inline: auto centres the frame in the full-bleed page and is the one exception; the ritual h1 and title block centre a heading, not a box)
no literal 1680px or 72rem outside the token declaration; no second width token
no change to the grid rule, the sidebars (gone), the wash, the pills, the masthead markup or the engine
shared_paths: every page's .page reads the same token; /Thing reads it through --thing-frame; the same Deploy Quartz workflow
authority_map.deletion_line: The two caps, the centring, the center/footer override and the two literal widths are deleted in the first commit; the token and the three reads are written in the same commit so the build never has no width.
